name: Sunstar Free Company
description: The Sunstar Free Company is the dogmatic cause-mercenary order of knights, squires and foot soldiers that serves as the de facto state army of the Celestial Palatinate.

description_citations.text: "Sunstar Free Company". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

description_citations.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities
description_citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Jay Annelli, Laurel Pratt, Amanda LaFranco. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

summary.text: The Sunstar Free Company is the dogmatic cause-mercenary order of knights, squires and foot soldiers that serves as the de facto state army of the Celestial Palatinate.

citations.text: "Sunstar Free Company". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citations.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities
citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Jay Annelli, Laurel Pratt, Amanda LaFranco. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

bio.text: It settled Adagia and declared itself administrator of the world, encasing it in mirrored superstructures to reflect extra light.

citations.text: "Adagia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Adagia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: The Palatinate sent its knights to stop the Monoists and deploy a horizon javelin at Sothera.

citations.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities
citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Jay Annelli, Laurel Pratt, Amanda LaFranco. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

bio.text: Its soldiers defended the Dawnsire against Monoist boarders, who overwhelmed them in a short fight.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

bio.text: It hunted Alpharael, sweeping Taro-duend with drones and infantry, then destroyed Taro-duend under Vondam's protocol seven.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

bio.text: Its squire Haliya came to believe the Sunstar, not Alpharael, bore responsibility for the dead Kav, and she broke with the company.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

bio.text: Reen killed three of its soldiers aboard a ship.

citations.work: Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero
citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero" by Rich Larson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

bio.text: Its fleets raced the Monoists to Infinite Guideline for the Endstone, and Vondam afterward degraded Haliya and cast her out.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

status.text: As of the latest story the company's fleets were attacking Infinite Guideline for the Endstone, with Haliya cast out and the company having violated its agreement with Pinnacle.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya tries to force Alpharael to alter the past; Vondam slaughters the Kav citizens, convincing Haliya the Summists were wrong, and the crew escapes.
timeline.quote: Vondam refused to hurt Haliya and opened fire on the Kav citizens instead, slaughtering them all.

citation.text: "Alpharael", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Seriema braking through Sigma's atmosphere detects a Sunstar palestar warship, which flies off after something else.
timeline.quote: The palestar's taking off toward the other side of Sigma, chasing something else.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Palatinate sends Sunstar Free Company knights to stop the Monoists and deploy a horizon javelin at Sothera.
timeline.quote: the Palatinate has dispatched a force of Sunstar Free Company knights to drive the Monoists out and deploy one of their javelins

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Jay Annelli, Laurel Pratt, Amanda LaFranco. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Raphaella's final transmission explains the Monoist purpose, describes the Dawnsire and Candela, and bids farewell as her inevitor falls toward Sothera.
timeline.quote: that we will destroy the Dawnsire

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 3" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The boarding party leaps for the inner hull toward the Sunstar defenders.
timeline.quote: Everyone casts their center of mass forward.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: A Sunstar foot soldier blinds Nagashua with a bladiator flash and kills her.
timeline.quote: He thrusts the bladiator through her heart.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Monoist boarders overwhelm the Sunstar defenders in a short fight.
timeline.quote: Then, it is over. Alpharael barely got to swing his axe.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Behind the hatch the boarders find a Sunstar basilica and someone begins burning it.
timeline.quote: It's a basilica, a house of the Sunstar faith.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Beams cut through the ceiling at Alpharael, but a thrown jar of aeromuck saves him from being killed.
timeline.quote: Two beams through the ceiling skewer Alpharael.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam accepts Alpharael's challenge, naming himself of the Sunstar Free Company.
timeline.quote: I am Syr Vondam of the Sunstar Free Company.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Tan notices a Sunstar Hopelight warmaker following them down.
timeline.quote: Just so you know, there's a fighter following us.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: A Free Company palestar fires lasers at the Hopelight, trying to shoot down its own fighter.
timeline.quote: The palestar is firing lasers at the Hopelight.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami learns the wounded Hopelight pilot is a Monoist who has stolen the Free Company's fighter.
timeline.quote: That's a Monoist name. In a Sunstar Free Company fighter.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael plays along, claiming the Free Company plans to destroy Sothera.
timeline.quote: The Sunstar Free Company plans to destroy Sothera

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: A Sunstar Free Company ship arrives at Taro-duend demanding the escaped spies.
timeline.quote: It's the Sunstar Free Company. They're demanding we turn over the escaped spies we're harboring.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 6" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael sees Sunstar Free Company knights and photophoroi landing at Taro-duend to search for him.
timeline.quote: And from that ship rains an armored rain: the tiny figures of Solar Knights descending on spikes of plasma.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Free Company sweeps Taro-duend with drones and infantry.
timeline.quote: The Free Company is everywhere.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Kav of Taro-duend resist the Free Company by sabotage and obstruction.
timeline.quote: In an act of aggressive, unilateral solidarity, the Kav are raising thirteen kinds of hell.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: A Free Company officer fires a microwave weapon on the crowd.
timeline.quote: One of the Free Company officers fires up a microwave weapon.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Free Company search at Taro-duend collapses under Kav resistance.
timeline.quote: The Free Company search is falling apart.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: A Hopelight pilot destroys half the airport while firing at a laser source.
timeline.quote: I blew up half the airport .

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Reen sees that her fellow passengers are three Sunstar Free Company men-at-arms.
timeline.quote: There are three of them: three men-at-arms belonging to the Sunstar Free Company, pride and blade of the Celestial Palatinate.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero" by Rich Larson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The soldiers fail to recognize Reen and walk past.
timeline.quote: She reminds the men-at-arms of nothing, and they stride past her without stopping.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero" by Rich Larson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: A Sunstar soldier catches Reen at the memory cores with a bladiator at her neck.
timeline.quote: The others didn't believe me. But I can always sniff out your kind.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero" by Rich Larson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Reen stabs the soldier in the eye with a pneumatic needle in the dark and flees.
timeline.quote: drives her pneumatic needle into something yielding and aqueous.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero" by Rich Larson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Reen sprints through the dark to the cargo hold with three soldiers in pursuit.
timeline.quote: Monoists revere the dark; Reen has spent half her life in lightless tunnels

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero" by Rich Larson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Reen locks herself in her suitcase while her armor assembles and the soldiers cut through the door.
timeline.quote: It splits open at the same time the cargo door hisses shut.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero" by Rich Larson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The soldiers breach the cargo hold.
timeline.quote: The sheared metal of the door topples forward, discharging another shower of sparks. The men-at-arms step through.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero" by Rich Larson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Reen surrenders to rage, activates her gravity gauntlets and emerges from the suitcase to fight.
timeline.quote: Reen activates her gravity gauntlets and emerges.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero" by Rich Larson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: After the fight, the maintenance mechans and Reen send the dead soldiers out an airlock.
timeline.quote: A moving wave of maintenance mechans conducted the soldiers to the airlock; Reen helped push their shattered corpses through.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero" by Rich Larson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam announces to all units that they are going to protocol seven and have two minutes.
timeline.quote: We are going to protocol seven. You have two minutes.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Sundog lasers every heat source in Taro-duend as it recovers its soldiers.
timeline.quote: The Sundog is killing everything in Taro-duend with its lasers.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya reflects that she can never be a Sunstar knight after the atrocity and her desertion.
timeline.quote: She will never be a Sunstar knight of the Free Company.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya argues that the Sunstar, not Alpharael, bear responsibility for the dead Kav.
timeline.quote: He's not responsible for the dead Kav at Taro-duend, either. We are.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya takes off her helmet and says the Free Company's armor is no longer hers.
timeline.quote: Haliya takes her helmet off, moving so sharply that Alpharael flinches away.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mantis reflects that the Free Company violated its agreement with Pinnacle and that Pinnacle stays neutral.
timeline.quote: The Free Company has violated the terms of its agreement with Pinnacle.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam warns that both sides will blockade the eternity column.
timeline.quote: That they must blockade the eternity column and prevent any ship from escaping Sothera.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam describes an unstable double stalemate as both fleets move toward Infinite Guideline.
timeline.quote: We are in an unstable double stalemate.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: A Free Company search radar sweeps toward the drifting Seriema.
timeline.quote: Search radar howls across the dark.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Free Company radar is abruptly jammed by an unseen attacker.
timeline.quote: The Free Company radar abruptly shuts off.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Fleets from both sides accelerate toward Infinite Guideline.
timeline.quote: Dozens of fusion-drive flames are accelerating toward Infinite Guideline and the eternity column.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Monoists and the Sunstar Company bid with speed to reach Infinite Guideline.
timeline.quote: The Monoists and the Sunstar Company are in a bidding war, and they are paying with speed.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya reluctantly aligns her Sunstar frequency-hopper so the Seriema can listen to Free Company traffic.
timeline.quote: It takes some verbal fencing before Haliya is willing to align her Sunstar Company frequency-hopper with the Seriema 's receiver.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Pinnacle lases the shadow shields of palestars braking too close, and the Monoists kill them.
timeline.quote: A pair of Sunstar patrol ships try to brake too close to Guideline, and Pinnacle shows its teeth

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya broadcasts to the Free Company that she has detached from Vondam's command and offers the artifact on Infinite Guideline.
timeline.quote: I have detached myself from Syr Vondam's command and placed myself on errantry.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The fighting continues around but does not touch the Seriema.
timeline.quote: But the fighting does not touch the Seriema.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: A ceasefire lets both sides crowd toward Infinite Guideline to receive the Endstone and destroy pursuers.
timeline.quote: Under cover of a ceasefire—to retrieve survivors, make repairs, and limp away—both sides crowd in toward Infinite Guideline, waiting to receive the Endstone from the Seriema and destroy its pursuers.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Solar Knights launch lightbridge boarding craft at Guideline.
timeline.quote: The Solar Knights are making a play for Guideline.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya insists on returning to the Free Company to report and beg Alpharael's pardon.
timeline.quote: I'm going to make my report and beg your pardon.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Pinnacle's Tactical Corps personnel independently decide to release their violence delegates.
timeline.quote: Release the violence delegates.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Pinnacle's mechan swarms target the radiators of the faiths' warships.
timeline.quote: Their target is the most vulnerable part of any warship—the radiators.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The hunger from space feeds on both Sunstar and Pinnacle forces but never on Monoists.
timeline.quote: But it does not feed on Monoists.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam formally degrades Haliya and bars her from knighthood.
timeline.quote: by my authority as a knight of the company, I hereby degrade you.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya is cast out of the Free Company and chooses to believe her choice was right.
timeline.quote: He has cast her out of the Free Company.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya places herself on errantry, still a Summist but cast out of the Free Company.
timeline.quote: I've been cast out of the Free Company, but I am still a Summist. I place myself on errantry.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Solar Knights board from the dock.
timeline.quote: "Solar Knights outside!" Haliya calls.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam commands a knightly host assigned to defend the Dawnsire.
timeline.quote: Syr Vondam is a high-ranking knight of the Sunstar Free Company who commands a knightly host assigned to defend the Dawnsire .

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Endstone changes history so that the Sunstar palestar never starts work on the planet and passes it by unharmed.
timeline.quote: and the palestar passed the planet by unharmed.

citation.text: "Endstone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Endstone manipulates a fight between the Sunstar Free Company and Kavaron's defenders to help Sami, Tannuk and Alpharael escape.
timeline.quote: The Endstone manipulated a fight between the Sunstar Free Company and the defenders of Kavaron to help Sami, Tannuk, and Alpharael escape.

citation.text: "Endstone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haliya finds Alpharael and tries to force him to alter the past with the Endstone; when nothing happens she tries to have everyone obliterated.
timeline.quote: When nothing happened, she tried to have them all obliterated by the Sunstar Company.

citation.text: "Endstone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Solar Knights reignite the star of Haliya's frozen homeworld; she joins the Sunstar Free Company and becomes Vondam's squire.
timeline.quote: The Solar Knights arrived and reignited the star

citation.text: "Haliya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sami and Tannuk save Alpharael after his ship crashes; Summists pursue, Haliya tries to steal the stone, and Sami and Tannuk flee Kavaron.
timeline.quote: allowing Sami and Tannuk to access the ship's controls and flee Kavaron

citation.text: "Sami", section "Hunt for the Endstone". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Summists massacre the civilians of Taro-duend to purge the Endstone's influence.
timeline.quote: the Summists massacred the innocent civilians in Taro-duend

citation.text: "Sami", section "Hunt for the Endstone". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The crew takes the Endstone to Infinite Guideline Station, uses the station to warp enemies into the Wurmwall, and Sami recovers Mirri.
timeline.quote: they managed to use the station to warp them out into the Wurmwall

citation.text: "Sami", section "Hunt for the Endstone". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sunstar Free Company settles Adagia and declares itself administrator of the world.
timeline.quote: where they quickly declared themselves the administrators of the world

citation.text: "Adagia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Free Company encases the world in mirrored superstructures to reflect extra light.
timeline.quote: The Free Company encased the world in mirrored superstructures, reflecting additional light onto the cold world.

citation.text: "Adagia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Astelli find an ally in the Sunstar Free Company.
timeline.quote: The Astelli have, for the time being, found a strong ally in the Sunstar Free Company of the Palatinate

citation.text: "Astelli", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: They rescue Alpharael, who is pursued by the Sunstar Free Company.
timeline.quote: rescuing him after his Hopelight warmaker crashed in the debris field

citation.text: "Mission for the Endstone", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: While evading Sunstar Free Company forces on Kavaron, the Seriema's radar is smashed and its main drive nozzle lasered off.
timeline.quote: her radar was smashed and the magnet nozzle for her main drive was lasered off

citation.text: "Seriema", section "Condition". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haliya tried to take the Endstone from Alpharael; Sami and Tannuk fled Kavaron, and the Summists massacred Taro-duend.
timeline.quote: the Summists massacred the innocent civilians in Taro-duend to purge the influence of the Endstone

citation.text: "Tannuk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: found a strong ally in the Sunstar Free Company
relations.quote: The Astelli have, for the time being, found a strong ally in the Sunstar Free Company of the Palatinate

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 3" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

relations.quote: Monoists like to swarm over them in cover and tear them apart.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

relations.note: Reen hates the Sunstar soldiers and kills the three aboard.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero" by Rich Larson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

relations.note: The Sundog is a Free Company palestar that carries out protocol seven.
relations.quote: the Sundog is recovering its soldiers.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 8" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

relations.note: The two fleets are in a bidding war for Infinite Guideline.
relations.quote: The Monoists and the Sunstar Company are in a bidding war, and they are paying with speed.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

relations.note: Vondam acts as a knight of the company.
relations.quote: by my authority as a knight of the company

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

relations.note: Haliya is a squire in the company.
relations.quote: Haliya is a bright and eager squire in the Sunstar Free Company.

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.
Luxknight Breacher (Edge of Eternities, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.quote: Haliya is a human aspirant of the Sunstar Free Company in the Edge .
